overview_description.description: CNTXT is an AI and data technology company that helps organizations transform their data and operational workflows into AI-ready systems and applications. The company provides data services, custom AI solutions, and AI products that support the development, deployment, and governance of artificial intelligence across enterprise and government environments. Its offerings include data sourcing, preparation, annotation, model evaluation, speech intelligence, and AI validation tools, with a particular focus on Arabic-language AI capabilities and regional linguistic expertise. CNTXT also develops domain-specific AI models and applications designed for sectors such as government, healthcare, finance, and legal services while emphasizing data sovereignty, security, and regulatory compliance. In addition, the company integrates AI, cloud, and data technologies to help organizations improve decision-making, automate processes, and manage AI systems at scale.
